LanguageData.Kiiro.ValorStorytellerDesc:
"...And at that moment, Valor {0} arrived just in time, drive off the pirates with her sword and save the day. {0} led the people to reclaim wastelands, rebuild homes, and raise high walls. Never again fearing villains, the villagers lived happily ever after."
"Mom, what happened to {0} later?"
"That's where the story ends. It's late now, good night honey."

The story never ended. She embarked anew on her own path of salvation, seeking the future of her people.

{0} tell a story mirror her adventures: filled with unknowns. You cannot foresee whether hardships or miracles awaits, but your own adventure begins here. Additionally, Kiiro events will be triggered more frequently.
